thread:
Nina: quick report  the weekly econ card surfaced negative 'cache savings' for tenant_1135 after the midnight pipeline run. screenshot in thread.
Carlos: can you paste the tenant id and window? i'll run the same query.
Nina: tenant_1135, 7d window. the summary shows -$6.30 but the timeline spikes back to +$4 on day 3.
Jules: that pattern looks like delayed amortization. reconcile job applied credits to a different ingest batch then redistributed later. transient negatives are expected.
Carlos: agreed. two dimensions: (1) backend temporal consistency (live vs reconciled), (2) how we present small-sample noise to end users.
Nina: product asked: "why is a savings metric negative" — they want a simple rule to avoid alarming PMs.
Jules: proposal: add a confidence interval + sample_count to the mini card. show the point estimate but grey the number when CI contains 0. Add a tiny "i" with sample_count.
Carlos: backend: add fields to the MV: reconciled_at, sample_count, and raw_prefetch_savings. then compute CI in the query using bootstrap-ish approximation: se = sqrt(var(prefetch_delta)/n); ci = mean +/- z * se. cheap and understandable.
Nina: i like CI. UX fallback rule: if sample_count < 60, show "insufficient samples" instead of a number. product wants a fallback so PMs don't see weird negative.
Jules: also add an API param `smoothing=none|ewma|ci` so power users can pull EWMA-smoothed values for noisy tenants. default remains none.
Carlos: implementation notes: EWMA can be computed incrementally in the MV with state: ewma_t = alpha * current + (1-alpha)*ewma_prev. but MV needs deterministic ordering; we'll compute per-day buckets.
Nina: deck request: include a one-liner explaining the CI approach and min-sample rule. i'll draft.
Jules: telemetry: emit `econ.card.render` with fields {tenant_id, mode:clamped|raw|ci, sample_count}. track toggles to `smoothing` and `show_raw`.
Carlos: safety check: add a CI-based smoke test in CI that fails if any tenant has point_estimate < -0.02 * monthly_cost AND CI_lower < -0.02 * monthly_cost (i.e., statistically significant negative). prevents shipping obvious regressions.
Nina: rollout plan: short: MV add reconciled_at + sample_count + raw field (Carlos) -> 0.5d. UI show CI + sample_count + min-samples fallback (Jules) -> 1d. add API smoothing param -> 0.5d. telemetry + CI smoke -> 0.5d. total ~2.5d.
Jules: UX text for small sample: "Insufficient samples to estimate amortized cache savings. Expand to inspect raw values."
Carlos: opened PR for MV changes (prs/4991). added reconciled_at and sample_count. will backfill last 90d.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: reconciler-mv-bump -> staging (by @Carlos) :gear:
Nina: i'll validate staging with tenant_1135 and a few tiny tenants. can we make the default card show CI upper bound (conservative) when CI includes zero? product prefers being conservative.
Jules: sure — rendering rule: if CI_lower <= 0 <= CI_upper then show 0 with a tooltip "estimate not statistically distinct from zero." otherwise show point estimate. still allow toggle to show raw.
Carlos: PR merged to staging, MV rebuilt. staging shows 'insufficient samples' for tiny tenants and CI for larger ones.
Nina: validated, looks good. added ENG-1401 to track per-model post-cache cost parity.
Jules: will follow up next sprint with EWMA mode and a small A/B to see which UX product prefers.
Nina: thanks all, tagging product for review. :white_check_mark:
